verdict.rationale: Medusa documents an Admin REST API with a maintained OpenAPI 3.0 spec. First-party Product, Order, Payment and Fulfillment modules exist, but the pack only gives their page titles. Nothing shows the specific admin operations the story names (order edits, refunds, fulfillment triggers) being exposed through that API. missing for 10: explicit admin API endpoints for creating products, editing orders, issuing refunds and creating fulfillments; detailed endpoint documentation; hands-on corroboration of lifecycle management via the admin API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage the full commerce lifecycle programmatically — create products, edit orders, issue refunds, trigger fulfillments — through the admin API

citations.quote: Medusa maintains complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specifications for the Store (and Admin) REST APIs in the medusajs/medusa repository
